title: Interior average potential energy
description: Essential: The answer for part (1) must be $-2a'N/V$.

title: Boundary average potential energy
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must be $-a'N/V$.

title: Pressure at boundary
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) must be $Nk_BT/V - a'N^2/V^2$.

title: Total energy expression
description: Essential: The answer for part (4) must be $\frac{3}{2}Nk_BT - a'N^2/V$.

title: Final temperature after expansion
description: Essential: The answer for part (5) must be $T - a'N/(3k_BV)$.

title: Entropy increase to first order
description: Essential: The answer for part (6) must be $Nk_B\log 2 - \frac{a'N^2}{2VT}$.

title: Potential energy integration
description: Important: The solution must integrate the pair potential over a uniform density to find the average energy.

title: Energy conservation in expansion
description: Important: For parts (5) and (6), the total energy must be conserved during the free expansion.

title: Bernoulli's law application
description: Important: For part (3), Bernoulli's law must be correctly applied, relating pressure difference to potential energy density difference.

title: Double-counting correction
description: Important: The total potential energy in part (4) must include a factor of 1/2 to avoid double-counting pairs.

title: Sign error in potential
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for the attractive potential energy (should be negative).

title: Missing factor in boundary energy
description: Pitfall: Failing to recognize that an atom near the boundary interacts with only a half-space, giving half the interior energy.

title: Ideal gas law misapplication
description: Pitfall: Using the ideal gas law for pressure at the boundary without the correction from intermolecular forces.
